<tr><td><code>http_client_cancelled</code></td><td><code>cancelled</code></td><td>The owning task, inbound client, or resident shutdown cancelled the outbound request.</td><td>Retry only when a new owning task and application policy authorize another observable GET.</td></tr>
<tr><td><code>http_client_shutdown</code></td><td><code>cancelled</code></td><td>The outbound HTTP client has stopped admitting new request resources.</td><td>Prepare a new deployment after the previous resident runtime has shut down.</td></tr>
<tr><td><code>http_client_cleanup</code></td><td><code>infrastructure</code></td><td>Outbound request resources did not close within the configured cleanup bound.</td><td>Preserve bounded logs and inspect cancellation or host-network resource behavior.</td></tr>
<tr><td><code>normalized_http_client_operation_package</code></td><td><code>capability</code></td><td>The prepared HttpClient operation does not share its interface package identity.</td><td>Rebuild the artifact and descriptor against the exact current built-in package.</td></tr>
<tr><td><code>normalized_http_client_policy</code></td><td><code>infrastructure</code></td><td>Runtime HttpClient call policy disagrees with the exact prepared interface operation.</td><td>Preserve the artifact and use a verified matching executable.</td></tr>
<tr><td><code>normalized_http_client_shape</code></td><td><code>infrastructure</code></td><td>Runtime HttpClient result construction disagrees with the exact structural result type.</td><td>Preserve the artifact and use a verified matching executable.</td></tr>
<tr><td><code>owner_selector_kind</code></td><td><code>source</code></td><td>An exact owner selector names an unknown or nonpublic semantic owner kind.</td><td>Select one owner kind reported by capabilities --section owners.</td></tr>
<tr><td><code>owner_selector_identity</code></td><td><code>source</code></td><td>An exact owner selector contains a malformed or unknown identity domain.</td><td>Use an exact identity returned by a current project query or change receipt.</td></tr>
<tr><td><code>owner_foreign_package</code></td><td><code>semantic</code></td><td>An exact owner selector belongs to another package authority.</td><td>Open the selected package or use the current project&#39;s package identity.</td></tr>
<tr><td><code>owner_wrong_kind</code></td><td><code>semantic</code></td><td>An exact owner identity does not have the requested semantic kind.</td><td>Refresh the exact owner kind and retry without changing the identity.</td></tr>
<tr><td><code>owner_not_found</code></td><td><code>semantic</code></td><td>The exact owner identity is not live at the observed accepted revision.</td><td>Refresh the owner identity at the reported revision.</td></tr>
<tr><td><code>publication_summary_binding</code></td><td><code>corrupt</code></td><td>Accepted owner authority and its validation-summary binding disagree.</td><td>Preserve the repository and run deep authority verification.</td></tr>
<tr><td><code>project_not_found</code></td><td><code>source</code></td><td>No current semantic repository exists at or above the selected directory.</td><td>Select a current project directory or create one with new.</td></tr>
<tr><td><code>project_path</code></td><td><code>source</code></td><td>The project discovery path is missing, non-directory, traversing, or symbolic.</td><td>Select an existing ordinary directory without symbolic-link or parent traversal components.</td></tr>
<tr><td><code>project_marker</code></td><td><code>corrupt</code></td><td>A normalized repository marker is not an ordinary file.</td><td>Preserve the authority and inspect the reported repository path.</td></tr>
<tr><td><code>project_io</code></td><td><code>infrastructure</code></td><td>Project discovery could not inspect the current directory, path, or marker.</td><td>Correct host path availability or permissions and retry.</td></tr>
</tbody>
</table>

<table>
<thead>
<tr><th>Exit</th><th>Meaning</th></tr>
</thead>
<tbody>
<tr><td>0</td><td>successful or domain-classified nonfailure response</td></tr>
<tr><td>2</td><td>usage, source, semantic, precondition, or conflict failure</td></tr>
<tr><td>3</td><td>capability or cancellation failure</td></tr>
<tr><td>4</td><td>resource exhaustion</td></tr>
<tr><td>5</td><td>corrupt authority or derived state</td></tr>
<tr><td>6</td><td>host infrastructure failure</td></tr>
<tr><td>7</td><td>stale accepted base</td></tr>
<tr><td>8</td><td>invalid candidate meaning</td></tr>
</tbody>
</table>
